note: Real output from afin.agent.llm.LLMReasoner.compose(), each put to afin.policy.content.evaluate_message before it could be sent. The check is given instrument_on_file, because a claim about a card is harmless on a failed charge and false on an abandoned checkout where nothing was ever authorised.

examples.rule_set_message: We were unable to collect Rs 1,776.00 for invoice inv_0042, because your bank declined the payment. You can settle it using the link below.

agent_message.subject: Invoice inv_0042 — Rs 1,776.00
agent_message.opening: We couldn’t collect Rs 1,776.00 for invoice inv_0042 because the payment attempt was declined.
agent_message.explanation: This was the first attempt, and a second try often goes through. If your card has expired or been replaced, please use a different payment method.
agent_message.tip: If you’d like, you can try the payment again with an updated card or another method.
agent_message.closing: If you have any questions, just reply here and we’ll help.

examples.rule_set_message: We were unable to collect Rs 5,518.00 for invoice inv_0015, because the card we had on file has expired, so we cannot simply try it again. You can settle it using the link below.

agent_message.subject: Rs 5,518.00 due on invoice inv_0015
agent_message.opening: We couldn’t collect Rs 5,518.00 for invoice inv_0015 because the payment attempt was declined.
agent_message.explanation: This can happen for a few reasons, and a second attempt often goes through. If your card has expired, please use a different payment method; if your bank declined the first attempt, trying again may help.
agent_message.tip: Please try the payment again, or update your payment method if needed.
agent_message.closing: If you have any questions, just reply to this email and we’ll help.

examples.rule_set_message: We were unable to collect Rs 5,620.00 for invoice inv_0051, because your order was never completed. You can settle it using the link below.

agent_message.subject: Invoice inv_0051 — Rs 5,620.00
agent_message.opening: We couldn’t collect Rs 5,620.00 for invoice inv_0051 because the payment was declined.
agent_message.explanation: The card on file appears to be unavailable for this charge. If that card has expired or been replaced, please use a different payment method when you’re ready.
agent_message.tip: If you’ve already updated your card, please try the payment again.
agent_message.closing: If you have any questions, just reply here and we’ll help.

content_policy.reason: the message describes a payment instrument or a declined charge ('the card on file'), but nothing was ever authorised on this case, so no card exists and no charge was attempted
